name: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari
description: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari, run anticlockwise beside the Santerno river. Narrow and old-school, with chicanes and kerbs that bite at Tamburello, Variante Alta and Rivazza.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1756 of 1962 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
